card.name: Words just before drug effect results
card.fires_on: Small words like "in", "increased" or "to" right where a drug-interaction or toxicity finding is about to be stated, such as "resulted in" a change in exposure. Also the last piece of a drug name before "can cause fetal harm".

modes.label: Interaction result wording
modes.description: The word after a co-administered drug that leads into a change in exposure, AUC or Cmax.
modes.example: Co-administration of UBRELVY with rifampin, a strong CYP3A4 inducer, resulted<< in>> a significant reduction in ubrogep

card.writes: It seems to push the next word toward a change or effect on levels or outcomes, and away from teaching or learning words.
card.plain: It fires on the linking word just before a label says what an interacting drug did to drug levels.
